metadata.name: [REP+] reHUD [Forked]
metadata.description:
Requires Repentance+. A Repentance+ port of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1906405707]reHUD[/url] by wofsauge. Adds a more customizable smaller version of the "Extra HUD", which displays the gametime and a list of collected items on the screen.
[h1][b]Disable or unsubscribe the original reHUD when using this fork![/b][/h1] Only one of the two runs when both are enabled.
[h1]Features[/h1] - [b]Display your collected items on the screen[/b], as many as fit, instead of the vanilla Extra HUD's short list. - [b]Customize the display[/b]: Position (Default: under the minimap, Bottom), Amount of Columns or Rows, Size, Text Size, Transparency, show or hide the timer, items and floor names. Follows the HUD Offset option. (Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Mod Config Menu Impure[/url] (recommended) or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681875787]Mod Config Menu Pure[/url]!) - [b]Display a more accurate ingame Timer![/b] Shows hundredths of a second ;) - [b]Filter your items[/b]. Display passives, familiars and/or actives, with or without temporary items (Lemegeton wisps, Zodiac, 3 Dollar Bill). - [b]Sort your items[/b]. Newest first, grouped under the name of the floor they were collected on.
[h1][b]Disable "Extra HUD" in the Options menu when using this mod [/b][/h1]
[h1]You need [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]"Mod Config Menu Impure"[/url] (recommended) or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681875787]"Mod Config Menu Pure"[/url] to customize this mod![/h1]
[b]This mod does [u]not[/u] disable achievements![/b]
[h1]Special Thanks[/h1] to wofsauge for the original reHUD! to Piber for the Mod config menu! to Skojanza for helping bugfix the original mod to _Kilburn for the screen-size helper in the original mod
